abstract: Deploy and operate llm-d on Kubernetes: the llm-d Router (EPP, InferencePool) over vLLM or SGLang pools. Covers the optimized-baseline quickstart in standalone and gateway mode, precise prefix-cache routing, prefill/decode and wide expert parallelism, tiered KV offload, flow control, KEDA autoscaling, rollouts, observability and upgrades. Verified against llm-d v0.10.0.
